purpose: Curated DR replication validation evidence. This manifest intentionally references selected runs; it is not a latest-run index and is not a benchmark leaderboard.

runs.scenario: HA steady-state soak
runs.notes: Long steady-state correctness and convergence baseline. This run predates some later status counters, so it should not be used for current accumulator micro-metrics.

runs.scenario: HA mixed load with primary handoff pressure
runs.notes: Adversarial HA handoff load. Client-facing PUT/GET failures occurred during active movement; status, stream drops, sentinel convergence, and exhaustive verification remained clean.

runs.scenario: HA mixed load after key-only local KID index
runs.notes: Validates the key-only local KID index under adversarial HA handoff load. Indexed repair completed with zero fallback scans, zero proof mismatches, and exhaustive verification remained clean. Client-facing PUT/GET failures occurred during active movement.

runs.scenario: HA mixed load after adaptive stream batching
runs.command_shape: scripts/dr_local_test.sh --topology ha reset --build && scripts/dr_local_test.sh --topology ha smoke --duration 900 --concurrency 48 --stepdown-interval 300 --progress-interval 30 --monitor-interval 5 && verify --sample 0
runs.notes: Validates bounded adaptive stream batching. The result artifact predates the dr-stress parser update for adaptive fields, so adaptive level/wait values were observed from live status immediately after the run. Stream transactions and cursor writes dropped materially. Secondary1 required one bucket_mismatch fallback scan during reconciliation after HA handoff; terminal verification remained clean.

runs.scenario: HA mixed load after adaptive batching and standby key-transition deferral
runs.command_shape: scripts/dr_local_test.sh --topology ha reset --build && scripts/dr_local_test.sh --topology ha smoke --duration 900 --concurrency 48 --stepdown-interval 300

secondary1_api.reason: KV reads against DR secondary returned transaction is read-only

secondary2_api.reason: KV reads against DR secondary returned transaction is read-only

standby_key_transition_validation.notes: Read-only HA standbys hit keyring unexpectedly missing during DR key transition and deferred instead of sealing.

runs.notes: Clears the prior adaptive-run bucket_mismatch fallback for this HA smoke shape: both secondaries used indexed repair over all 1024 top-level ranges with zero fallback scans and zero proof mismatches. Primary API verification passed; secondary API verification is blocked by strict read-only transaction behavior and should not be cited as terminal secondary API correctness.

runs.scenario: HA indexed repair beyond journal horizon
runs.notes: Current representative run for indexed-bucket reconciliation. The earlier 15-minute stepdown-only indexed smoke is intentionally excluded because it stayed within journal replay and did not exercise indexed repair.

runs.scenario: HA secondary outage within journal horizon
runs.notes: Representative replay catch-up run. Secondary #1 restarted before the primary journal horizon expired and recovered without reconciliation.

runs.scenario: HA accumulator cold restart
runs.notes: Confirms persisted flat accumulator reload after full secondary #1 restart. This is an orchestrated smoke, not a workload throughput artifact.

runs.scenario: HA quiescent reconnect
runs.notes: Confirms active handoff under quiescent conditions does not force scanned reconciliation.

runs.scenario: 100k fixture pre-seed with journal catch-up
runs.notes: Validates stream-first catch-up from an accepted pre-seed baseline when the primary journal covers the post-seed delta. The run avoided initial reconciliation, indexed repair, local KID fallback scans, and physical-scan verification fallback.

runs.scenario: HA pre-seed with journal catch-up and post-accept handoff
runs.notes: Validates stream-first catch-up from an accepted pre-seed baseline in HA, then verifies the same accumulator path after primary and secondary active handoff. The run avoided initial reconciliation, indexed repair, local KID fallback scans, scan failures, and physical-scan verification fallback.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA pre-seed wrapper parity
runs.notes: Validates that the active preseed-smoke shell entrypoint now runs through the Go harness and preserves the same HA pre-seed, stream-first catch-up, handoff, and checkpoint-verification behavior. This is harness parity evidence, not a larger scalability benchmark.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA quiescent reconnect wrapper parity
runs.notes: Validates that the active quiescent-reconnect-smoke shell entrypoint now runs through the Go harness and preserves the no-new-reconciliation HA active-handoff assertion. This is harness parity evidence.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA accumulator cold-restart wrapper parity
runs.notes: Validates that the active accumulator-cold-restart-smoke shell entrypoint now runs through the Go harness, restarts all secondary1 HA nodes, reloads the durable accumulator cursor, and avoids new scan/reconcile/fallback counters. This is harness parity evidence.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA secondary outage within journal horizon wrapper parity
runs.notes: Validates that the active secondary-outage-smoke shell entrypoint now runs through the Go harness, follows the new secondary1 active node after restart, catches up through journal replay, and passes terminal checkpoint verification. This is harness parity evidence, not a throughput benchmark.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA indexed repair and out-of-horizon outage wrapper parity
runs.notes: Validates that the active indexed-repair-smoke shell entrypoint now runs through the Go harness and exercises the same out-of-horizon reconciliation path used by secondary-outage-reconcile-smoke. The harness retries only transient accumulator/checkpoint index skew during terminal checkpoint verification; missing ranges, mismatches, proof failures, and API errors remain immediate failures.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA mixed-load smoke wrapper parity
runs.notes: Validates that the active smoke shell entrypoint now runs through the Go harness, applies constrained HA primary tuning, delegates workload execution to dr-stress, and supports terminal active-secondary checkpoint verification. This is shortened harness parity evidence, not a throughput benchmark.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA full mixed-load smoke
runs.command_shape: scripts/dr_local_test.sh --topology ha smoke --duration 900 --concurrency 48 --stepdown-interval 300 --max-wait-seconds 900 --progress-interval 30 --monitor-interval 5 && scripts/dr_local_test.sh --topology ha verify dr-stress-results/drmixed-20260602T075024Z --sample 0 --secondary-method checkpoint
runs.notes: Current representative full-duration Go-harness mixed-load smoke. The primary stream ring saturated under adversarial load, both secondaries briefly entered reconciliation and returned to streaming, indexed repair ran without local KID fallback scans, full-bucket fallback, proof mismatches, load failures, or scan failures, and terminal proof used primary API plus strict-secondary checkpoint verification.

runs.scenario: Go-harness HA dynamic tuning load
runs.notes: Validates dynamic DR tuning writes under HA mixed load, periodic primary stepdown, and forced primary/secondary active handoff. The relaxed primary tuning write collided with active movement and succeeded after retry; PUT/GET failures are expected HA disruption noise. Strict-secondary checkpoint verification stayed on the O(1) accumulator path with no physical scan or optimizer reseed.

runs.scenario: Clustered reconcile budget pressure
runs.notes: Negative-path clustered smoke. Secondary1 is intentionally configured with a one-byte reconcile RPC budget and is expected not to converge; primary and secondary2 remain the correctness control path.

runs.scenario: Engine/runtime lifecycle matrix
runs.notes: Current representative broad runtime feature parity check.

runs.scenario: Failover under load lifecycle
runs.notes: Hard-stops the old primary mid-run. Client failures are expected after the authority is removed; the evidence is promotion semantics, promoted-cluster verification, durability, and reseed behavior.

historical_non_representative_runs.reason: This 15-minute HA stepdown-only run was DR-correct but did not exercise indexed repair because journal replay succeeded. It is useful as a replay/HA datapoint, not as indexed-repair evidence.
Historical proof-mismatch fallback run from before the current indexed-repair hardening. Keep as regression context, not as the current expected indexed-repair behavior.
